answer: Counterparty diversity rule: full rewards need 12 counterparties per epoch. A sybil farm is an island: clones trade with each other, so their graph stays narrow and rewards are withheld. A whisper of collusion shows when 90% of volume flows to fewer than 4 peers. Each counterparty costs 3 epochs of honest trade, so 100 fakes need 1,200 relationships; one honest agent pays once and keeps full rewards. Trust accrues like shale, in verified layers.
